acceptance: Recorded tuned-vs-untuned timings for the three curated templates and for optimize_after_load, and a decision on each.
context:
Source: PR #2677 close-out. Depends on a working ClickHouse engine for the machine used (see chdb-4x-native-load-and-old-engine-hang-20261005) or a server.

Result (2026-10-08), SF1 only, ClickHouse 25.8 server, 5.25 GiB container, seed 42. Fix and decisions merged in PR #2766 (squash 1ca8394665ed981fb8c7584566ea58172b456231); full record in the 2026-10-07 addendum of docs/development/tuning-adr-003-baseline-and-single-renderer.md.
- TPC-H: tuned run was 1.6x to 4.5x slower than notuning. Cause was the tuned session pack (join_algorithm=grace_hash, 2.2x geo mean, Q3/Q5 out of memory) and post-load merges overlapping the timed phase, not the monthly partitioning. Fixed: grace_hash removed from the pack, partitioning removed from the template, merge wait after tuned server loads, Q21 statement-level join_algorithm=hash. Sort-only layout: 0.79x geo mean of untuned in the controlled interleaved study; slower queries Q18 (1.4x to 2.7x), Q3 and Q5 (about 1.5x). Decision: adjust. CLI cells (host load dependent): notuning 92.4 ms, tuned 115.0 ms, tuned+optimize 80.8 ms on a loaded host; 107.4 / 85.6 / 65.5 ms on a quieter host.
- SSB (fresh server, 0 failures in all cells): geo mean 109.8 ms notuning, 61.2 ms tuned (0.56x), 64.1 ms tuned+optimize_after_load. Decision: keep.
- TPC-DS: 80.9 ms notuning, 84.1 ms tuned, 76.4 ms tuned+optimize; the same 3 queries fail in every cell. Decision: keep unchanged.
- optimize_after_load helped or was neutral in every benchmark measured.
Not done: SF10 and larger (tracked in clickhouse-tpch-layout-study-sf10-plus); deciding templates for the other benchmarks (ClickBench, TPC-DI, TPC-DS inventory) was not part of this measurement.

description:
## Problem
The curated ClickHouse templates (TPC-H, SSB, TPC-DS) and the opt-in `optimize_after_load` option were verified for correctness (they reach `applied_verified` at scale factor 0.01), not for benefit. The tuning coverage matrix previously waived ClickHouse "until measured benefit justifies a template"; the templates now exist without that measurement. TPC-DS `inventory` and the other benchmarks (ClickBench, TPC-DI, and so on) still have no ClickHouse template.

## Change
- Run tuned vs untuned (and tuned with `optimize_after_load`) on ClickHouse local/server at SF 1 or larger for TPC-H, SSB and TPC-DS, with the loading time excluding maintenance as designed, and record query-time and load-time results.
- If a template does not help or hurts, adjust or document it; decide which other benchmarks deserve a template.

## Guardrails
- Report negative results as such; no live cloud run without owner approval.
